visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a title screen featuring a Toblerone chocolate bar and its box against a dark background. A cartoon avatar of a male character is positioned in the top-left corner. Large yellow and white text appears at the top. (2) The scene shifts to a red background with a number '1' and text referring to KitKat. A real hand is seen breaking a chocolate bar, followed by an animation of the bar breaking with a 'Snap' effect. (3) An animation shows a Coca-Cola bottle and a male cartoon character gesturing toward a silhouette of the bottle on a black background. Text overlays describe psychological effects. (4) A Toblerone box is displayed, followed by a transition to a real-world hand holding the box against the backdrop of the Matterhorn mountain in a snowy landscape. (5) A close-up shot shows real hands unboxing an Apple laptop. The white box is opened slowly on a clean, light-colored table, revealing the sleek metal laptop inside. (6) Images of various MUJI products on shelves are shown, followed by the cartoon male character explaining minimalist concepts on a dark background. (7) A Pringles can animation appears, showing a character holding the can. The video concludes with the cartoon character expressing surprise and a final logo screen.
